Blustin & Associates has more than 30 years of experience providing transaction, planning and litigation-related services to its individual and business clients.
We use that experience and a sophisticated researching capability  to help clients resolve legal problems, plan for the future and operate their businesses on a day-to-day basis.

Client representation has spanned a variety of industries and disciplines, including, automotive, sports  entertainment (Pro Wrestling and MMA) engineering, media, transportation and logistics, manufacturing, product development, software protection, construction, real estate development, retail stores and professional services. The types of services provided to these clients include (1) intellectual property protection, copyright and trademark prosecution, rights clearance, licensing and royalty negotiations; and university research contracts; (2) advertising law compliance; (3) general business advice and strategic planning; (4) litigation; (5) mergers and acquisitions; (6) nonprofit formation and compliance; (7) real estate; (8) government contracting (defense, SBIR, demilitarization, and intellectual property development); (9) employment issues; (9) estate planning; (11) real estate; and (12) environmental, chemical and biotechnology engineering.
